Module it.polimi.ingsw
Package it.polimi.ingsw.Controller.Server

Class TurnHandler

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.Controller.Server.TurnHandler
All Implemented Interfaces:
EndOfTurnSubject
public class TurnHandler extends Object implements EndOfTurnSubject
The TurnHandler class manages the turn-based logic of the game. It keeps track of the active player, the current turn phase, and the turn number. It also notifies observers at the end of each turn.
